component.name: ChatToon
component.summary: 3D co-host for live streams, with local AI and voice
Coapresentador 3D para lives, com IA local e voz

description.p: ChatToon is an animated 3D character that reads your live chat on YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok and more at the same time, answers with its own sense of humour and talks with a real voice. The AI runs on your computer with Ollama and the voice comes from TTS BigLinux: nothing is sent to the cloud.

O ChatToon é um personagem 3D animado que lê o chat da sua live no YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok e outras ao mesmo tempo, responde com humor próprio e fala com voz de verdade. A IA roda no seu computador com o Ollama e a voz vem do TTS BigLinux: nada vai para a nuvem.

ul.li: Six characters with expressions, gestures and lip sync
In OBS Studio with a transparent background, or in a window on the desktop
Install and control Ollama and the voice engines from the app
Live privacy mode that hides addresses and secret codes on screen
